propositions: Duration probe must be refactored from 1127 lines into two stdlib-only modules: thin CLI layer (rebar_duration_probe.py) and reusable support library (rebar_duration_probe_support.py) to stay within 800-line canonical cap.

Gated-close phase breakdown must distinguish direct metrics, direct event intervals, and inferred residuals, reading COMPLETION_VERDICT, STATUS, and SIGNATURE timestamps to report pre-verifier, deterministic verifier, LLM verifier, and verdict-to-status phases.
CLI must accept --log-root, --tracker, --since, --until, --provider-prefix, and --current-since with documented repository-neutral defaults and reproduce frozen analysis with unchanged percentiles.
Probe must classify unmatched, no-LLM, forced, interrupted, and incomplete operations distinctly from completed model-backed cohorts without implying uninstrumented boundaries.
